attrs.evidence: The in-tree battery closes the DIRECT-READ channel. A two-run checker over a model of the runner exhibits a timing channel that a file-observer misses — validating the holdout before the gate leaks through duration alone. Until 27a declares what the low observer can see, the strong statement has no truth value for the real runner, and 27b's meter-faithfulness precondition is only partly discharged.
